title: Women Rights Helpline Contact Cards
problem: Women in our village facing domestic trouble suffer silently because they don't know where to call for legal help or shelter support.
idea: Small, discreet helpline cards that fit inside a purse or ration card cover. You tap the problem, and the page tells you which free number to call.

widgets.heading: 📞 Which number should she call?
widgets.intro: Tap the problem. All these numbers are free.
widgets.question: What is happening?

options.label: Danger right now
options.te: ఇప్పుడే ప్రమాదం ఉంటే 100 లేదా 112 కి ఫోన్ చేయండి.

options.label: Trouble at home, needs support
options.result: Call 181 – Women Helpline. They can connect you to counselling, a One Stop Centre (Sakhi) and shelter.
options.te: 181 మహిళా హెల్ప్‌లైన్‌కి ఫోన్ చేయండి. సలహా, సఖి కేంద్రం, ఆశ్రయం కోసం సహాయం చేస్తారు.

options.label: Needs a free lawyer
options.result: Call 15100 – NALSA free legal aid, or visit the District Legal Services Authority at the court.
options.te: ఉచిత న్యాయ సహాయం కోసం 15100 కి ఫోన్ చేయండి.

options.label: A child is in trouble
options.te: పిల్లలకు ఇబ్బంది ఉంటే 1098 కి ఫోన్ చేయండి.

items.title: Violence is wrong
items.text: No one is allowed to beat, threaten or lock up a woman at home. The law protects her.
items.te: ఇంట్లో స్త్రీని కొట్టడం, బెదిరించడం నేరం. చట్టం ఆమెకు రక్షణ ఇస్తుంది.

items.title: Right to stay safe
items.text: She can ask for protection and a safe place to stay.

items.title: Free legal help
items.text: Women can get a free lawyer through the Legal Services Authority.
items.te: మహిళలకు లీగల్ సర్వీసెస్ అథారిటీ ద్వారా ఉచిత లాయర్ లభిస్తారు.

items.title: SHE Teams
items.text: Telangana SHE Teams help women facing harassment. Reach them through 100.
items.te: వేధింపులకు గురైన మహిళలకు తెలంగాణ షీ టీమ్స్ సహాయం చేస్తాయి. 100 ద్వారా సంప్రదించండి.

questions.why: 15100 connects you to free legal aid.

options: So she can keep it hidden and safe
questions.why: A small card can be kept secretly in a purse or cover.

how: Ask Gemini to explain women's basic rights against violence at home in simple Telugu.
Check every helpline number with my teacher or on an official government website.
Open Canva and choose a 'business card' size template.
Use plain colours and small text so the card looks ordinary and stays private.
Add the numbers 100/112, 181, 15100, 1098 and 108 with tiny icons.
Print many cards and give them quietly through the Anganwadi teacher or SHG leader.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. In simple Telugu and English, explain in 5 short lines that domestic violence is wrong and a woman has the right to protection and free legal help. Mention helplines 181 (women), 100/112 (police) and 15100 (free legal aid). Keep it kind and calm.
